title: Rav Mazuz Supports Reconciliation
body: Rav Tzemach Mazuz, rosh yeshiva of Yeshiva Kisei Rachamim, urges reconciliation and mutual respect at a gathering for a yeshiva bochur released from Israeli military prison for refusing to report to the Draft Office.

title: Rav Yosef on Yeshiva Arrests
body: Rav Yitzchok Yosef, former Rishon LeTzion, spoke out against arrests of yeshiva students, claiming they were mistreated in military detention during his weekly shiur in Yerushalayim.
